cohort.filter: spot_ready=true AND perp_ready=true AND canonical outcome present

balanced_router.core: spot_adaptive_direction == perp_adaptive_direction AND (perp_sign_change_count_60s >= 2 OR sign(spot_normalized_ofi_5s) == agreed_direction)
balanced_router.venue_rule: FADE final imbalance sign when final and 60s mean signs agree; otherwise FOLLOW final sign
balanced_router.fill: on venue disagreement only, publish stationary technical logistic direction when abs(p_green-0.5) >= 0.06
balanced_router.technical_refit: 16-opportunity blocks; for block b train prior eligible non-PUSH rows with indices [0,b-2); no fit when b-2 < 16
balanced_router.technical_model: median imputation + RobustScaler(25,75); categorical most-frequent + one-hot; LogisticRegression(C=0.03,max_iter=5000,L2,lbfgs,no class weight)

precision_stack.primary: balanced candidate AND prior_trend_age_candles < 12; keep balanced direction
precision_stack.rescue: primary abstains AND balanced candidate AND prior trend age >= 12 AND prior upper-wick percentile96 <= 0.20; flip balanced direction
